statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH; extreme Stress persists while current NQ weakness remains modest and mean reversion is still visible.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold; ADP and the U.S. cash-open/data cluster are the next material checkpoints.
headline: Extreme stress, but NQ path still mean-reverting
body: Nasdaq-100 futures were about 0.2% lower, with a fresh quote near 29,069 after an earlier 29,038 reading, while VIX stayed near 16.4. Oil above $95, the 10-year yield above 4.8%, and U.S.-Iran escalation keep cross-asset stress extreme, but current evidence does not show sustained no-retracement NQ extension.

lookbackSummary: Over the prior 24 hours, Tail ranged from watch to high: Tuesday's U.S. selloff produced several red trend-down readings, while late-session and overnight retracements repeatedly pulled Tail back below the block threshold.
outlookSummary: Stress remains extreme. Forecast Tail rises conditionally around ADP, the cash open, the 14:00-14:30 UTC data cluster, the Beige Book and Broadcom; sustained extension with shallow or failed retracements is required for elevated or higher Tail.

forecast.analysis: Current: Nasdaq-100 futures are only modestly lower and have rebounded from an earlier premarket low; VIX is near 16.4. Oil above $95 and the 10-year yield above 4.8% keep Stress extreme, but no persistent no-retracement NQ path is verified.
drivers: Modest NQ weakness with an observed rebound
U.S.-Iran escalation keeps cross-asset stress elevated

news.title: Asian stocks slide and oil rises as Middle East tensions lift yields
Stock market today: Nasdaq futures slip as oil and yields stay elevated

forecast.analysis: The next hour remains pre-ADP. Tail stays in watch territory unless fresh NQ evidence shifts from modest weakness into sustained extension with shallow pullbacks; elevated oil and yields keep Stress pinned high.
drivers: Fresh NQ persistence would be required to lift Tail
Oil and yields remain potential amplifiers

forecast.analysis: With ADP approaching, event sensitivity rises. Tail reaches the top of watch only if pre-release price discovery becomes one-way; otherwise the main effect is extreme Stress rather than proven mean-reversion failure.
drivers: Event sensitivity increases before the release

forecast.analysis: ADP lands during this hour. The elevated Tail forecast is conditional on a post-release move that extends with weak retracement; an orderly two-way reaction would invalidate the elevated path even if the data surprise is large.
drivers: Event surprise alone does not establish Tail

forecast.analysis: The U.S. cash open begins at 13:30 UTC. Tail is elevated only if the opening auction reinforces the ADP direction with repeated extension or failed pullbacks; opening volatility by itself is Stress, not Tail.
drivers: Failed pullbacks would strengthen Tail evidence

forecast.analysis: Factory Orders at 14:00 UTC and EIA petroleum data at 14:30 UTC create a dense catalyst hour. Tail 30 assumes aligned rates/oil/NQ continuation; retracement and cross-asset stabilization would argue for a rapid drop.

This is the first full hour after the data cluster. Elevated Tail requires a genuine second directional leg or continued session-extreme holding; orderly retracements would weaken the pathological-path case quickly.
If the opening and data impulses have been absorbed, the baseline returns to watch. Tail would stay elevated only if NQ continues to reject meaningful retracement while cross-assets remain aligned.
drivers: Meaningful NQ retracement would lower Tail

forecast.analysis: Mid-session structure becomes more important than the morning headlines. Tail stays watch unless the market develops repeated directional extension after failed retracements; otherwise elevated volatility remains primarily Stress.
drivers: Repeated extension would be the escalation trigger

forecast.analysis: The Beige Book is released at 18:00 UTC. Elevated Tail is conditional on a rates-driven repricing that becomes persistently one-way; a volatile but retracing response would leave Stress high without confirming Tail.
drivers: Rates response is the main transmission channel

forecast.analysis: The U.S. power hour begins at 19:00 UTC. Tail stays at watch unless the session develops persistent extreme-holding or renewed extension after failed retracements; a two-way close would keep the risk primarily in Stress.
drivers: U.S. power hour begins at 19:00 UTC
Closing path quality is the key checkpoint

forecast.analysis: The U.S. cash close and Broadcom's after-close release window converge in this hour. Elevated Tail is conditional on a directional closing impulse that carries into technology futures; the earnings outcome is not assumed.
drivers: Broadcom scheduled to report after the close

forecast.analysis: Broadcom's conference call begins at 21:00 UTC. Tail is elevated only if the verified post-release reaction becomes persistent in semiconductors and NQ futures; the content and market response remain unknown until observed.

The first full post-call hour can transmit Broadcom repricing into NQ futures. Tail remains elevated only if the move extends with shallow retracements and broader technology confirmation; a two-way response would lower it.

After-hours repricing may persist, but the elevated forecast requires continued directional extension rather than a single earnings gap. Fading semiconductor pressure or a broader NQ retracement would move Tail back toward watch.
drivers: Retracement quality after the earnings impulse

forecast.analysis: By the next UTC session, the baseline returns to watch unless the after-hours technology move has persisted into a broader one-way futures path. Mean reversion or cross-asset stabilization would keep Tail below the block threshold.

Overnight liquidity can exaggerate moves, but Tail remains watch unless NQ keeps extending without meaningful retracement. Stable yields and a fading technology-specific reaction would favor a mixed path.

Absent a fresh catalyst, the forecast assumes more two-way overnight structure. Tail would rise only if the earlier earnings or geopolitical impulse develops into repeated extension across the low-liquidity session.
drivers: Repeated extension would invalidate the mixed baseline

forecast.analysis: The baseline becomes more normal if overnight futures retrace and cross-assets stabilize. Tail remains watch because geopolitical and rate sensitivity persist, but no future one-way structure is presumed.

A quieter pre-Europe hour is the baseline. Tail stays watch unless oil, yields and NQ unexpectedly realign into persistent directional extension; otherwise the dominant structure is expected to remain normal rather than one-way.

Europe approaches with residual geopolitical and rate sensitivity. Tail would increase only if the handoff creates fresh extension and shallow pullbacks; a stable transition would preserve the mixed/watch baseline.
drivers: Fresh extension at the regional handoff is conditional

forecast.analysis: European cash-open sensitivity starts to build. Tail stays watch unless a new cross-asset directional alignment appears; the later U.S. data calendar is a future checkpoint rather than evidence in this hour.
drivers: Later U.S. data are not current price-path evidence

forecast.analysis: The Europe-to-U.S. handoff begins to matter more. Tail reaches the top of watch if yields or oil re-accelerate alongside NQ weakness, but elevated Tail still requires observed persistence rather than a hypothetical data reaction.

U.S. premarket attention shifts toward the 12:30 UTC data and Fed Waller. Tail remains watch unless fresh futures structure becomes persistently directional before those checkpoints; event importance alone does not justify a block.
drivers: Pre-event persistence would be required for higher Tail

forecastDetail.comment: Current evidence is mixed: NQ weakness is modest and has retraced, while oil, yields and geopolitics keep Stress extreme.
Pre-ADP, Tail remains watch unless fresh futures structure becomes persistently one-way with shallow pullbacks.
ADP proximity increases whipsaw risk; Tail is still watch because the future price path is not yet observed.
ADP is the first danger-window checkpoint; elevated Tail is conditional on persistent post-release extension.
The cash open can amplify an ADP move; elevated Tail requires opening-auction continuation or failed pullbacks.
Factory Orders and EIA form the densest catalyst hour; Tail 30 requires aligned, persistent cross-asset continuation.
